name: integrations
title: Integrations
description: Several rows of dark rounded tiles, each holding a thin line icon over a soft patch of coloured light, slide across a black background at different speeds and directions. The tiles fade up one by one and the stack darkens toward its edges.
use: A landing page wants a moving wall of partner or integration icons behind or beside a heading.
avoid: The rows run forever and the tiles carry no names, so visitors cannot tell which app each icon is.
a11y: The icons have no text alternative and the endless marquee ignores reduced-motion, so it cannot be stopped. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stack of horizontal rows filled with near-black rounded-square tiles. Inside each tile sits a thin outline icon such as a globe, heart, rss or shield, above a blurred blob of orange, pink, blue, green or yellow light, and the bottom rows fade into black.
behaves: Every row glides sideways on a loop, some in the opposite direction, so icons pass each other at differing rates. Tiles start black and fade in at random delays when the section scrolls into view, while a gradient dims the lower edge.
customise: Nothing is exposed: the six icons and their glow colours are written into the component, so changing brands means editing the tiles array.
weight: moderate: Six tiles repeated five times per row across several rows, with marquee animation always running.
